verse.verse_1: WHEN THE SKY is split asunder,
verse.verse_3: When the oceans begin to flow,
verse.verse_5: Each soul will know what it had sent ahead and what it had left behind.
verse.verse_6: O man, what seduced you from your munificent Lord
verse.verse_7: Who created you then formed your symmetry, then gave you right proportion,
verse.verse_8: Shaping you into any form He pleased?
verse.verse_9: Even then you deny the Judgement.
verse.verse_10: Surely there are guardians over you,
verse.verse_13: The pious will surely be in heaven,
verse.verse_15: They will burn in it on the Day of Judgement,
verse.verse_16: And will not be removed from it.
verse.verse_17: How can you comprehend what the Day of Judgement is?
verse.verse_18: How then can you comprehend what the Day of Judgement is?
verse.verse_19: It is the day when no soul will have power to do the least for a soul, and God's alone will be done.
